notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

First off, thanks to all who have given this game a try.  I appreciate any amount of time you've spent with the game.

Secondly, the feedback that I've been getting seems to center around features and expectations that the game is not. I've updated the store to better reflect the goal and purpose of the game. 

Additionally, I've released a patch to include the following:

[list]
    [*]Added "Help" button which provides gameplay tips
    [*]Restructed mercenary prices
    [*]Restructed Camping Feature to allow plays to end a run as they wish
    [*]Restructed Camping Feature to auto heal
    [*]Buffed Goblin base stats. (The idea here is to encourage ability use and strategic play.  I apologize in advance for the Purple Goblins)

[/list]

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Just pushed a small patch that should make the character selection screen a bit clearer.  Additionally, Goblin base stats have been buffed across the board.  

[b]Update #1[/b]
[list]
    [*]Added Party UI elements at character select
    [*]Added Ability UI flash to battle UI
    [*]Buffed base stats for all Goblin types
[/list]
